DATA STANDARD / PROVENANCE

Observed means saved from the source screenshots during review. Calculated means a metric derived from manually reviewed player positions. Interpreted means a tactical reading linked to source timestamps.

The source archive has 122 screenshots covering 00:00–01:00.5 at half-second intervals; this portable report retains their timestamp manifest and reviewed observations, not the source PNGs. The source clip metadata gives 61.226 seconds; its final 0.726 seconds have no sample. Twenty-eight whole-second samples have individual positions carried forward from the earlier review. A blank map sample means the player could not be located confidently, not that the player was absent. The exact game edition, round sides, region boundaries, routes, player outcomes and objective outcome remain unverified.

Map alignment is an approximate visual match. Player positions are estimates, with lower confidence when icons overlap or are obscured. Trails connect separate samples; movement between them was not observed. Heat shows where reviewed positions recur, not continuous time spent there.
